name: firefly/security
description: LaraFly security core: a first-party immutable SecurityContext/Authentication principal model persisted in the session, form login with a shipped sign-in page, HTTP Basic, remember-me, logout, a negotiating authentication entry point, memory + Eloquent user stores, JWT + OAuth2 resource-server authentication, deny-by-default URL and method authorization (#[PreAuthorize]/#[PostAuthorize]/#[Secured]/#[RolesAllowed]/#[PreFilter]/#[PostFilter]) enforced at the CQRS bus, the controller dispatcher and on any stereotyped bean through the shared proxy chain, a no-eval whitelist expression evaluator, the Spring authentication/authorization event family, principal injection into controller actions, CSRF + security-headers hardening filters, and test support. Secure-by-default, fail-closed, zero boot reflection.

suggest.firefly/actuator: The /actuator/health endpoint whose `when-authorized` show-details this package answers (SecurityActuatorAutoConfiguration).
suggest.firefly/openapi: The OpenAPI document whose per-operation `security` this package fills in from the compiled method-security rules (MethodSecurityRequirementContributor).
